checks.name: Rust formatting
checks.why: Unformatted Rust makes diffs noisy and review slower; formatting is mechanical, so it never reaches a human.

checks.name: ESLint
checks.why: Catches React hook misuse and unused or unsafe code in the frontend before it runs.

checks.name: TypeScript typecheck
checks.why: A type error, including a stale generated binding, would otherwise only surface at runtime in the app.

checks.name: Web component tests
checks.why: Breaks in UI behaviour against mocked IPC; jsdom tests give the same answer on every OS, so they run once.

checks.name: Build web assets
checks.why: Tauri embeds web/dist at compile time, so Clippy and the Rust tests cannot compile without it.

checks.name: Clippy
checks.why: Lints and platform-specific code (cfg(target_os)) only compile on the platform they target, so it runs on both macOS and Windows.

checks.name: Rust tests
checks.why: Proves Core API, Provider contract and bindings behaviour on each supported platform; --locked stops CI from resolving a stale Cargo.lock.

checks.name: Generated bindings are committed
checks.why: Running the tests regenerates web/src/bindings.ts; a diff means the committed TypeScript bindings are stale. Fix: run the Rust tests and commit the file.

checks.name: Tauri crate and JS packages share major.minor
checks.why: tauri build refuses mismatched versions, so a half-landed Tauri bump must fail the PR instead of the bundle.

checks.name: Licenses, bans and sources
checks.why: Stops a dependency we cannot legally or safely distribute (bad license, banned crate, non-crates.io source) from shipping.

checks.name: Dependency review
checks.why: Rejects a PR that adds an npm or Rust dependency with a high or critical advisory or a non-allowlisted license.

checks.name: Conventional Commit PR title
checks.why: The squash title becomes the main commit and the release-notes entry, so it must follow the Conventional Commit format.

checks.name: Lint workflows
checks.why: A syntax or expression error in a workflow must fail a PR instead of silently disabling CI.

checks.name: Audit workflows for security issues
checks.why: Catches expression injection, over-broad token permissions and unpinned actions in review.

checks.name: Tooling tests
checks.why: The DevOps decision logic (catalogue, gate, Dependabot policy, release gates) is code; a bug there silently weakens every other check.

checks.name: macOS app bundle
checks.why: A debug cargo test never runs tauri build; this catches a broken Tauri config, capability, icon or frontend embedding before merge.

checks.name: RustSec advisories
checks.why: A new advisory against an untouched crate gets noticed daily without blocking unrelated PRs; RustSec also reports yanked and unmaintained crates.
